{{Quote|Excellent, Major, excellent! I can't tell you how delighted we all are to see you. These rioters have obviously been suborned by local Rebel factions. They simply will not listen to reason, Major, and my militia forces are no longer sufficient to put them down. I insist that you take action immediately.|Cathers, to [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Fenris Sarhl]]|<ref name="heroes" />}}
'''Cathers''' was the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends#Imperial Governors|governor]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Demnadi]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following attacks and riots perpetrated by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] on Demnadi, he asked for assistance in dealing with the threat, and was glad when [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Fenris Sarhl]] of [[CompForce/Legends|CompForce]] arrived. However, when Cathers questioned how many squads Sahrl's relief force consisted of, the major answered that he was the only one who was sent.<ref name="heroes" />
